instruction: A chunky three-wheeled delivery trike with an oversized front cargo crate, fat balloon tires and a comically small handlebar bent into a smile. Everything is built from soft rounded volumes with thick chamfered edges, painted in cream, tangerine and mint with bold dark outlines baked into the seams. A single round headlamp and a curled brass bell sit above the crate like eyes and a nose.
